verdict.rationale: Fin has dedicated documentation for 'Building Fin Procedures' and 'Giving Fin Guidance', which describe encoding step-by-step SOPs with branching logic for known issue types, plus a Fin Agent API 'Run a procedure' orchestration endpoint that lets ops trigger these procedures deterministically. This directly matches the support-ops story of encoding SOPs with deterministic branching, though the docs are titles/summaries only without deep detail on branching semantics or independent hands-on validation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party walkthrough of branching logic mechanics, and independent/hands-on confirmation that procedures behave deterministically in practice.
